data.title: 砂狼白子 · 晨曦软被中的狼耳微颤
data.description: 晨光穿透旧窗帘洒在阿拜多斯的宿舍单人床上。白子侧卧在纯白被褥间，修长白皙的双腿微微蜷缩在薄被里。当被温热的指尖轻抚过头顶敏锐的狼耳尖端时，少女的双颊骤然泛起一层可爱的绯红，狼耳因敏感而软软地伏下，眼眸泛着迷蒙水汽，展露出平素难得一见的温驯与依赖。
data.location: sun-dappled cozy bedroom in early morning silence
data.action: lying on side in bed in light blue camisole, wolf ears flattened adorably with blush, cheeks flushed pink, blue eyes looking up with sweet docile vulnerability
data.lighting: warm gentle morning sunbeams reflecting off white bedsheets
data.mood: heart-fluttering docile sweetness, rare intimate vulnerability
data.promptProse: Lying curled on a sunlit bed in a light cotton camisole, Shiroko blushes softly as her wolf ears flatten in sweet surrender. Her crystal blue eyes gaze up with endearing, unguarded affection in morning warmth.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko lying on a sunlit bed with blushing cheeks and flattened wolf ears, gazing up gently.
